note: Set B correctly identifies the maximum total thickness for each airfoil span (e.g., 100mm for 301, 50mm for 211@77%), which aligns with the chart y-axis maxima. Set A frequently misbinds these maximum thickness values to the Trailing Edge (TE) or specific s-coordinates where the airfoil is visually thin, resulting in physically implausible claims (e.g., 105mm thickness at TE). Set B has some contradictions and layer misattributions, but Set A has more fundamental errors in geometry interpretation and coordinate reading.
